column1: # REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R2.tsv -- P05-S4 R2 pre-registration. Written BEFORE any R2 matrix run.
# Scope: allocation sites with the s4malloc route (AL01-AL17), fft_plan_dft_2d call index 1..5 (P01-P05),
#   fft_plan_exec call index 1..10 (EX01-EX10), on the three trees B, A and F; the plain driver of each tree.
# Columns (10, matrix_r2.py format): case family tree request NTH stack mode NG expected_class basis
#   tree: BASE = tree B (37a82e8), CUR = tree A (876181c), F = frozen tree (1c11905).  The tree is the column.
#   basis: the source line (git show) for the expectation, then the derivation.  The DIFF_VS_R1 note is inside basis.
# Judge: testing/d003/judge_d003.py classify() from rc, rc1, rc2, hit.  The driver PASS/FAIL line is never read.
# Status of every row: INFLUENCED.  The historical records (S2R3, S2R5, S2R6, S3R, S3R2 and the R1 registry
#   REGISTRY_S4_PRE.tsv) were read before this file was written, so no row is a blind prediction.
# Deferred to R3 and NOT in this file (not run): AL18 fft_alloc_complex (kottke:78, needs kottke_alloc family);
#   SI01-SI02 solve_info (needs the linearsolve family; the seam anchors on F do not match, see ERRATA_2);
#   FE01-FE10 (fmmret seam not built on F); info=NULL seven sites (U2 seam, not built); CLM1-4, ACF1, EXP40.
# Limit L-PLAN: the injector counts calls of fft_plan_dft_2d (nth = call index), not FMM source lines.
#   P01-P05 are the five FMM plan sites by source; a request can only name the call index, so one row per index.
# Limit L-EXEC: mode=exec is a BOUNDARY SIMULATION: the wrapper returns 1 and never runs the plan.  The judge marks
#   such rows "(boundary simulation)"; they are not evidence of a real execution failure.
# Limit L-SCRATCH: the AL rows use the s4malloc route, which counts S4_malloc calls per translation unit by NTH.
#   NTH is the call index of that routing, taken from the source order of the file (verified in this round).
# Source lines read in this round: git show 37a82e8 (B), 876181c (A), 1c11905 (F).  Line numbers differ between trees.
